title: 第2035章 还真的不能急第2034章 各种的怀疑
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
第2035章还真的不能急！
此刻——
他们心中满是怀疑，各种猜测不断。
而这时的火凤王，则完全没理会序颜父亲等强者，拎着火刀向序颜等那边走去。
“吃了喝了，不付账怎么行？”
火凤王说道：“你们得付账！”
“还请住手！”
序颜父亲等强者，快速来到序颜等身前，挡下火凤王。
“朋友，这里发生的一切，我们已然知晓，他们确实错了，但还是想请朋友给他们一个机会。”
序颜父亲对着火凤王说道。
李飘冉父亲没有说话，站在人群中，面色阴沉，眸子深处不时闪烁过强烈的杀意。
其他强者能跟火凤王平静谈话，他不能！
他儿子死了，被火凤王所杀。
这他如何能平静？
讲真——
要不是来前老祖对他几次三番嘱咐，他早就忍不住地杀过去，为他儿子报仇了！
那可是他亲儿子，不是表的！
他现在默念各种稳定道心的经篇，这才勉强压下心中的怒火，不然他真忍不了！
“机会是相互的，他们此前可曾给我机会？杀一次也就算了，把我烤掉吃了，我也不说了，但他们后面呢？”
火凤王说道：“他们后面竟是没有任何的悔改，甚至还升级了，对我进行各种的活烤、活蒸！最后还想将我捉走，留着以后再吃！”

它越说越气。
“这换做是你们，你们能就这么算了？”
它幽幽地说道。
序颜父亲等没有说话。
要说序颜等做的确实有些过分，吃一次就行了，咋还就吃不够呢？
这是得有多馋！
难怪火凤王会揪着不放。
这换谁，谁也不可能就这样轻易算了！
换做他们的话，也是如此！
不过——
这毕竟是他们的女儿和各自势力内的强者，他们怎样也不可能说不管。
“还请朋友息怒，朋友这不也是没事吗？”
序颜父亲道：“一切都是可以谈的，我们好好谈即可！”
“没什么是不可以谈的，尤其是在这个节骨眼上，难不成朋友真想让他人趁虚而入，坐享其成？”
“此时大战对我们都没有好处，只会白白便宜了他人！”
content_en:
Chapter 2035 You really can’t rush!
At this moment——
Their hearts were full of doubts and all kinds of speculations continued.
At this time, the Fire Phoenix King completely ignored Xu Yan's father and other powerful men, and walked towards Xu Yan and others with the fire knife.
"After eating and drinking, what can I do if I don't pay the bill?"
Fire Phoenix King said: "You have to pay the bill!"
"Please stop!"
Xu Yan's father and other powerful men quickly came to Xu Yan and others to block the Fire Phoenix King.
"Friends, we already know everything that happened here. They are indeed wrong, but we still want to ask our friends to give them a chance."
Xu Yan's father said to Fire Phoenix King.
Li Piaoran's father did not speak. He stood in the crowd with a gloomy face, and strong murderous intent flashed in the depths of his eyes from time to time.
Other strong men can talk calmly to Fire Phoenix King, but he cannot!
His son died, killed by the Fire Phoenix King.
How could he be calm?
Tell the truth -
If his ancestor hadn't told him several times before coming here, he would have been unable to resist and kill him to avenge his son!
That's his own son, not a superficial one!
He is now silently reciting various sutras that stabilize the Taoist mind, and then he can barely suppress the anger in his heart, otherwise he really wouldn't be able to bear it!
"Opportunities are mutual. Have they ever given me a chance before? They can kill me once and roast me and eat me. I won't say anything. But what about them later?"
Fire Phoenix King said: "They didn't show any repentance afterwards, and even escalated to the point where they roasted and steamed me alive! Finally, they wanted to capture me and keep me for later!"
The more he talked, the angrier he became.
"If it were you, how could you just let it go?"
It said quietly.
Xu Yan's father and others did not speak.
It should be said that what Xu Yan and others did was indeed a bit excessive. Just eat it once, so why don't you eat enough?
How greedy is this!
No wonder the Fire Phoenix King would hold on to it.
No matter who it is, no one can just let it go so easily!
It would be the same if it were them!
But——
After all, this is their daughter and a powerful person in their respective forces, and there is no way they can say no to it.
"Please calm down my friend. Isn't this okay, my friend?"
Xu Yan's father said: "Everything is negotiable, we just have to talk about it!"
"There is nothing that cannot be discussed, especially at this juncture. Is it possible that my friend really wants others to take advantage of the situation and enjoy the benefits?"
"A war at this time is not good for us, it will only give others an advantage!"
